messages:
Rae (People Ops): FYI Maya Chen (Product Designer) accepted onsite loop for Mon June 14. Needs sketching surface, paper + pens, Mac loaner, and note that she has a severe lactose intolerance. Can we confirm room and logistics?

Priya (Hiring Manager): I prefer Mon afternoon 1:304:00 to give panel time in morning. Can maybe compress to 2 interviews + debrief.

Hector (Interviewer): Morning is tight for me. Afternoon 1:30 works. I'll be remote for first 20m (commute) but can join Zoom.

Marta (Scheduler): Candidate availability: Mon afternoon only. She flies in same day and asked for a single contiguous block. Request: paper sketch pad, black pens, and blank whiteboard access.

Liam (Office Admin): I'll book Quiet Room B (south wing) and mark it as "low foot traffic". I can also stage a MacBook Air with charger and an external mouse. Catering: lactose-free boxed lunch confirmed.

Rae (People Ops): Approve rideshare up to $45 or parking reimbursement. Let's offer rideshare to simplify. Priya approves budget?

Priya (Hiring Manager): Approved, charge to hiring budget. Please include receipts policy in invite.

Hector (Interviewer): Noted about remote join. Marta, please add a 10m tech-check buffer at 1:20 so Maya can set up.

Marta (Scheduler): Draft schedule:
```
Mon Jun 14
13:20-13:30  Tech check + setup (Quiet Room B / Zoom)
13:30-14:10  Interview 1 (Priya)
14:10-14:50  Interview 2 (Hector)
14:50-15:20  Panel debrief
Notes: MacBook Air + sketchpad + pens provided. Lactose-free boxed lunch at 12:30. Rideshare voucher issued.```

Liam (Office Admin): I placed a note on Maya's badge for dietary restriction and will have an escort meet at lobby 13:00. Also left a spare set of pens (black) and an A3 sketch pad.

Rae (People Ops): I'll DM Maya the rideshare instructions and request arrival ETA. Marta, send invites once voucher is active.

Marta (Scheduler): Voucher active. Invites sent to panel + candidate. Closing thread unless something else comes up :white_check_mark:
